column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 2 Golgotha prison / Leburobs (verified subset)
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: My name is $$レブロブス$$.
Back when I was free, they even called me the strongest of the white $$羽$$...
If you were thrown into this waiting room too...
then you're a $$死刑囚$$ who committed the same $$七つの大罪$$ I did, right?
What, you didn't know?
This is the $$生けにえの待合室$$—a dumping ground for $$死刑囚$$s!
Who the hell are you?!
What did you say, bastard?!
That guard $$ピリポ$$ is a born coward, so
the other guards are always picking on him something awful.
Tch! That weakling!
Watching him get pushed around all the time makes me sick!
Hah! Someone of exalted rank?
Give me a break!
A $$大神官$$?!
So what if some $$神官$$ is important?!
Hah, sounds like bullshit!
If they have so much power, they should have escaped this place ages ago!
It's a lie, a lie!
It's got to be some fraud old man!
Besides, this is the infamous $$生けにえの待合室$$!
Tch, what a joke! I'm going to bed.
